title: Harden encoder runtime hardware matrix evidence
summary: Strengthened the synthetic encoder runtime matrix so dormant hardware rows have explicit default-skip evidence, HDR-capable hardware topology evidence, and fail-closed assertions for hardware descriptors that cannot preserve HDR10 metadata.
reason: Encoder breadth remediation still needs broader hardware/HDR runtime matrix coverage before any dormant hardware family can be activated. This adds validation evidence without changing descriptor activation, media policy, or FFmpeg command generation.
behavior_before: The runtime matrix skipped hardware rows by default and reported a generic skip count, but it did not assert that every hardware row was skipped by default or that HDR-unsafe hardware descriptors failed closed inside the matrix.
behavior_after: The runtime matrix now counts hardware rows, asserts all hardware rows are skipped unless MEDIAPIPELINE_ENCODER_RUNTIME_HARDWARE=1 is set, verifies HDR-capable hardware flag topology before skip, and proves HDR-unsafe hardware descriptors throw before FFmpeg flag construction.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --check - passed; 1760 source files current, no orphan summaries

rollback_plan: Revert the runtime-matrix assertion additions and the matching active-status documentation updates; no runtime encoder behavior or source-media behavior changed.
